image_description: A close-up portrait of a juvenile orangutan with shaggy reddish-brown fur, looking directly at the camera. The background is a soft-focus outdoor scene featuring green grass and a white building structure.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Broad flat face with prominent cheek pads in mature males.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The subject is clearly a juvenile/infant orangutan. It lacks the large, fleshy cheek pads (flanges) characteristic of mature males. The face is broad but smooth, consistent with youth.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Dark brown eyes with forward-facing binocular vision.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Eyes are dark, round, and forward-facing, exhibiting clear binocular alignment typical of primates.
One ear is partially visible on the left side; it appears small and rounded, consistent with orangutan anatomy, though partially obscured by fur.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Large body with tall, substantial proportions when standing.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The image is a tight head-and-shoulders crop. The full standing height and body proportions cannot be verified from this framing.
The fur texture is distinctly long, coarse, and shaggy with a vibrant reddish-brown hue, matching the species description perfectly.
The chest area is largely obscured by the angle and fur density, and the lower torso is out of frame. Cannot definitively verify barrel shape.
The rear of the animal is not visible in the frame. While orangutans do not have tails, this specific checkpoint cannot be visually confirmed.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Extremely long arms with exceptionally broad wingspan adapted for brachiation.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The arms are mostly out of frame or obscured by the body/fur. The full length and wingspan cannot be assessed.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Long-fingered hands with opposable thumbs and big toes.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: Hands and feet are not visible in this portrait shot.

artifact_observations.reasoning: Slight softness/haloing where the fine hairs meet the blurred background. This could be natural depth-of-field bokeh or slight AI generation blending issues, but it is subtle.

The white building in the background has slightly warped geometry (roofline angles), which is common in AI-generated backgrounds but also possible with wide-angle lens distortion. Low severity as it is out of focus.
